claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, m-chlorophenylbiguanide is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent; its only characterized cellular activity is 5-HT3 receptor agonism, which does not produce a killing pattern in cancer cell lines.
